## About Me {.section-label}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="65%"}

### Who I Am

I'm a graduate student in the **Master of Science in Digital Marketing (MSDM)** program, with a focus on analytics, data-driven strategy, and communicating insights to non-technical audiences. I work professionally at **BC Stats**, where I apply quantitative methods to real policy and program questions.

I'm passionate about the intersection of marketing strategy and data science — specifically how digital behaviour data (web analytics, GA4, BigQuery) can be transformed into actionable decisions. My culminating experience project centres on measuring what actually drives conversion, not just what *looks* like it does.

Outside of work and school, I'm building a running-and-bodyweight fitness routine, tinkering with Mac hardware, and slowly making my way through too many open browser tabs.

:::
::: {.column width="35%"}
